adjudication.rationale: In `app/assets/javascripts/discourse/models/group.js`, `removeMember` and `addMembers` call `Discourse.ajax(...).then(function() { self.findMembers(); })` without any rejection handling, and the admin controller actions (`removeMember`, `addMembers` in `admin-group.js.es6`) also don’t attach `.catch`/error UI. The diff shows these endpoints can return 422 for automatic groups (`Admin::GroupsController#add_members`/`#remove_member`), but the diff does not prove whether `Discourse.ajax` has a global error handler that would surface the 422 to the user, so “fail silently” isn’t fully verifiable from the diff alone.
